Item information of the rating scale model

Source: R/fct_rsm.R
Ii_rsm.Rd

The Fisher information of each item at an ability value, \(I_j(\theta) = \sum_k (dP_{jk}/d\theta)^2 / P_{jk}\). Under the rating scale model every item shares the same thresholds, so every information curve has the same shape and differs only by a shift of \(\lambda_j\). The test information is the sum of the item information. It returns the same result as catR::Ii(model = "RSM").

Usage

Ii_rsm(theta, bank, D = 1)

Arguments

theta

Ability.

bank

Matrix of item parameters, one row per item: column 1 is the location of the item \(\lambda_j\), the other columns the thresholds \(\delta_1\) to \(\delta_m\), the same in every row (which makes it the rating scale and not the partial credit model). A 5-point Likert item, scored 0 to 4, needs 5 columns.

D

Metric constant, 1 or 1.702.

Value

A list with Ii, the information of each item.

See also

Other rating scale model: Pi_rsm(), density_function(), eap_est_rsm(), eap_se_rsm(), integrate_cat(), likelihood_rsm(), next_item_rsm()

Examples

bank <- matrix(c(-0.560, -0.230, 1.559, 0.071, 0.129,
                 rep(1.715, 5), rep(0.461, 5), rep(-1.265, 5), rep(-0.687, 5)),
               nrow = 5,
               dimnames = list(1:5, c("lambdaj", "delta1", "delta2", "delta3", "delta4")))
Ii_rsm(theta = 0, bank)
#> $Ii
#> [1] 1.5020380 2.7204563 0.1074066 3.0614345 2.9586254
#> 
sum(Ii_rsm(theta = 0, bank)$Ii) # test information
#> [1] 10.34996
